name: Question card
summary: Card with a big question-mark badge and a question text that pops in; for quiz and hook frames.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y; the card grows with the question

params.name: question
params.note: question text; wraps to up to four lines

params.name: color
params.note: badge colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
